blocks.value: Buying a share is only half of the journey. At some point, you may decide to sell it to book profits, reduce losses, or invest your money elsewhere.
Imagine This: You bought a bicycle for ₹5,000. Two years later, someone offers you ₹6,500. You decide to sell it because you've made a profit. Selling shares works in a similar way.

To sell a share, simply select it from your Holdings, choose the quantity, and place either a Market Order or a Limit Order. Once a buyer matches your order, the shares are sold and the money is credited to your trading account.
You purchased one share of TCS at ₹3,200. A few months later, it reaches ₹3,650. You sell it and earn a profit of ₹450 before taxes and charges.
Congratulations! You now understand the complete journey—from opening an account to buying and selling your very first share.

blocks.question: How can you sell a share?
choices: Select it from Holdings and place a Sell Order.
